messages:
mira: quick heads-up: planning a cross-service roll tonight 23:00 UTC. targets: api:v2026-03-21.2, runtime:2.3.1, router:0.9.5, console:1.12.0. need final sign-off on pins, canary plan, and rollback triggers.

sam: request to lock runtime to 2.3.1 across hosted + dedicated. last 2.3 rollback due to kv-thrash on long sessions; fallback should be 2.2.8.

jordan: console has no schema changes. router header-split will be toggled by canary policy. sequence suggestion: api -> runtime -> router -> console.

mira: proposed canary: 5% x15m, 25% x10m, then 100%. stagger 60s between service steps.

rita: rollback criteria: abort if any during canary: API 5xx >0.5% sustained over 5m; p50 latency +75ms over baseline for 10m; runtime OOMs or kv-evict >3x baseline or >10 uncaught exceptions/min. Manual abort via /deploy abort <run-id>.

sam: add console visual regression check (grep for `render_error`) and alert devex on function/tooling failures. note: kernel-quant path enabled only in canary - watch tokenization and kv miss rate.

mira: locking pins: runtime:2.3.1 (fallback 2.2.8), console:1.12.0, router:0.9.5, api tag v2026-03-21.2.

jordan: will add route rule to force-fail new console to 0% if error_rate >1% (fail back to previous). injecting into canary policy.

mira: deploy command I'll trigger: `/deploy orchestrate --services api,runtime,router,console --canary 5 --canary-duration 15m --staged 25,100 --stagger 60s --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 --tag v2026-03-21.2`

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id:20260321-120) by mira at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary plan [5% x15m,25% x10m,100%]. Auto-rollback thresholds set per thread.

rita: add runbook link and incident notify (#incidents). include sample traces for p95 regressions.

mira: starting the run in ~20m; speak now to hold.

jordan: ready. monitoring hooks in place; watching header-split and router metrics.

deploy-bot: run 20260321-120: canary phase started for api and runtime. 5% traffic to new variants. Monitoring hooks active.

mira: monitoring. ping here for anomalies.

rita: ops abort snippet for runbook: `/deploy abort 20260321-120 --reason "auto-threshold"` then `/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8`.

sam: will note console bundle and kernel-quant toggle in release notes.

mira: will update release_notes.md after completion with metrics and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
